mandatoryCriteria: Row-level locking: Validates token by SHA-256 hash lookup in project_invitations under a PostgreSQL FOR UPDATE lock on POST /api/v1/invitations/accept
Email identity verification: Authenticated session email must strictly match invitation recipient email; mismatch returns 403 EMAIL_MISMATCH without creating membership
Expiration handling: Expired tokens (expires_at <= NOW()) transition status to 'expired' and return 400 INVITATION_EXPIRED
Atomic membership activation: Valid acceptance atomically transitions invitation status to 'accepted' and activates project_memberships with invited role and active status
Single-use token enforcement: Tokens already accepted or revoked reject reuse with 400 or 409 error
R2 Audit compliance: Pending invitation cannot restore deliberately removed access without a fresh authorized invitation issued after removal
Idempotency support: Accepts Idempotency-Key and returns identical membership activation outcome on replay without duplicate side effects
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: POST /api/v1/invitations/accept route, row-level FOR UPDATE locking, email identity matching against session actor, atomic project_memberships insertion, and idempotency handling on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: UI invitation acceptance screen is handled by the UI role.
